messages:
alex: spotting a few /embed rows in telemetry with email-like fragments. very low volume but reproducible. :grimace:

maria: ugh. which route and SDK versions?

alex: realtime /v1/embed, mix of SDK/direct. some shorthands like 'bob@acme' without TLD slipped past client scrub.
devon: short-term fix: ingress should redact before export. long-term: store encrypted raw and only export redacted copies; unmask via audited flow.
sam: enterprise customers will push back if we silently strip raw logs. need explicit opt-in with KMS + RBAC and immutable audit trail.
jess: console UX: show redacted preview. "Request full view" opens modal requiring 2FA + free-text justification + audit category. auto-reseal after 30m.
rohan: sampler idea: keep base_rate tiny per-route, but reactive spike_mode on anomalies. enforce tenant_daily_cap so costs don't blow up. log redaction_hints but don't trust them for final decision.
maria: quick ingress regex to catch shorthands: `re.sub(r"[\\w._%+-]+@[\\w.-]+(\\.[a-zA-Z]{2,})?","[REDACTED_EMAIL]", payload)` and emit redaction_misses metric (hashed examples). gate ML scrubbers behind feature flag.
devon: API support: accept `X-Redact-Hint: email,phone` for heuristics only. final redaction must be deterministic server-side.
sam: action: I'll model cost impact if spike_mode triggers. need worst/best-case GB/day.
jess: I'll prototype the unmask modal and audit view. include throttles and recent-unmask list.
rohan: devon+me will draft a short RFC for quota-aware sampling + delayed-unmask (due EOW).
infra-bot: deploybot: canary deploy ingress-redact v2 -> prod/us-west-2 started (build 7033).
alex: thanks. if we see any high-severity leaks we'll pause embed telemetry export until KMS + unmask controls are in place. :thumbsup:
